answers: The tester's round-1 failure (the dialog's own actions leaving the window once the related section fills) and the architect's two decisions on it: fix the overflow, and stop the pending state being announced at every pause.

proof.criterion: The new-issue dialog keeps offering its own actions — Create, Cancel, and the duplicate refusal's Create anyway — once the related section fills. (The tester's red row, run unmodified.)
proof.surface: Dispatch dashboard new-issue dialog in Chromium at 375x667, the phone window the dialog's full-bleed sheet layout below xl is for; real Go Dispatch server, production SPA bundle, Postgres 18.6 with pgvector
proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun run build:web && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=2 e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts
proof.observed: 8 passed (30.6s), the tester's row 'the dialog's own actions stay in the window once the section fills' among them, 2 of 2. The form now caps its height at the window and scrolls (max-h-[100dvh] overflow-y-auto, xl:max-h-[calc(100dvh-6rem)] so the wrapper's own p-4 pt-20 stays outside the cap), so Create and, after the POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE refusal, Create anyway are both brought whole into the window by scrollIntoViewIfNeeded. The tester's row, its helpers and its fixture are unchanged: `jj diff -r 479726710ce2..@` over that file shows only the two aria-busy assertions added to the display-gate row.
proof.negativeControl: The two overflow classes removed from the form and the SPA rebuilt: the tester's row red 2 of 2 with its own message, 'Create stands outside the 667px window: top 651.53125, bottom 695.53125', while the other three rows stayed green — so the row is red on the defect and nothing else, and the classes are what clear it.

proof.criterion: A screen reader hears the check's answer, not 'Checking for related items…' at every pause in someone's typing.
proof.surface: the same browser suite, the display-gate row, reading the live region's own aria-busy on the real surface
proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=2 e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts:199
proof.observed: 2 of 2 green. While a check is out the section carries aria-busy="true", so a polite live region holds its announcement; once the answer for the title in the box is shown it carries aria-busy="false" and the answer alone is announced. Both states are asserted in the row that already drives them deterministically under a held clock.
proof.negativeControl: `aria-busy={checking}` removed from the section and the SPA rebuilt: the row red 2 of 2 at `expect(related).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "true")` with 'Expected: "true", Received: ""', so the assertion reads the attribute and not a default.

proof.criterion: No regression in the dialog the fix changes, or in the rows round 1 proved.
proof.surface: the repository's Chromium suites that drive the create dialog and the palette, plus this change's own spec
proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard-issue.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard-palette.e2e.ts
proof.observed: 48 passed (2.1m): the four rows of this spec and every row of the three keyboard suites, 'c opens the create dialog; project and title create an issue the API returns and the SPA opens' among them.
proof.negativeControl: The same four specs are the only ones in packages/dispatch/e2e that drive the create dialog (`grep -l 'Create issue' e2e/*.e2e.ts`), so the set is the dialog's own callers and not an arbitrary selection.

filesChanged: packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/CreateIssueDialog.tsx — the form caps its height at the window and scrolls
packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/RelatedItems.tsx — aria-busy while a check is out; the answer narrowed into one `answer` value so the form takes a defined one
packages/dispatch/e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts — two aria-busy assertions in the display-gate row; the tester's row untouched
packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md — the busy state and the dialog's scroll
trickyParts: aria-busy is the fix the architect chose over moving the pending line out of the live region: a polite region holds its announcements while it is busy, so the reader hears the answer alone, and the line stays visible for everyone else.

Pulling the pending state into a named `checking` flag loses TypeScript's narrowing of `query.data`, so the component now computes one `answer` value (undefined while a check is out or while the box has moved past the title the query answers) and branches on that; `RelatedForm` still takes a defined `Suggestions`.
discoveredComplexity: The defect was not phone-only: the tester measured Create anyway 39 px below the fold at 1280x720 as well. The cap is on the form rather than on the related section, so it holds however the dialog's other parts grow.
